name: Triangle BLUE
source:
"Akane, I love you..."
"......I-I...love you too, Asato......"

Our relationship started after that.
After going out for 4 years and graduating from the university, we decided to live together.
I found a job at a publishing house. Akane enrolled at a vocational school as a step to realize her dream.

"My drawing with Asato's writing, let's make a book together. That's my dream."

Akane's smile, my most precious treasure. The thing I love the most.
No matter how busy we become we trust each other. We love each other.

I always thought these days would last forever.
So, until he came...

Remake of [url=/v2696]TRA-BLU[/url] with added NTR routes.
translation:
“茜，我爱你…”
“……我、我也…爱你，朝人……”

我们的关系就这样开始了。
交往四年、大学毕业后，我们决定共同生活。
我在一家出版社找到工作，茜则进入专门学校，为实现梦想迈出一步。

“用我的画配上朝人的文字，我们一起做一本书吧。这就是我的梦想。”

茜的笑容，是我最珍贵的宝物，也是我最深爱的东西。
无论生活多么忙碌，我们始终互相信任，彼此相爱。

我一直以为这样的日子会永远持续。
直到他出现…

[url=/v2696]《TRA-BLU》[/url]的重制版，增加了NTR路线。
